notes.title: New Expansion Pack: East Indies!
notes.content:
V1.4.3:
• Added East Indies Expansion Pack
• Added filtering to mission log viewer
• Enemy aircraft are now grounded in heavy rain (moddable)
• Removed download timeout (for slow network connections)

• Watch out for the Akizuki destroyers: They launch depth charges out to either side rather than dropping them off the stern.

Expansion Pack includes:

notes.title: v1.2.9 change list

notes.title: v1.2.6 change list

notes.title: v1.2.2 change list
notes.content:

notes.title: V 1.1.1 change list
notes.content:

• Fixed bug where unspent upgrade credits could be lost between Campaign patrols
• Fixed notification times using 12-hour format
• Fixed bug that could prevent some waypoints loading from a savegame file
• Fixed deck gun repeat-firing if mouse cursor stays over fire button after clicking

notes.title: Version 1.0.8 patch notes
notes.content:
• When you “Save As...” a Campaign patrol, it will now continue as a Campaign (not a standalone Patrol)
• When you “Save As…” or continue a custom-named game, auto-saves will continue to use that file.
• Add a Side Mission in the first 30 seconds of a patrol (to give new players an objective)
• Holding down fire button/key repeat-fires deck gun
• Only notify player & reset time scale if enemy torpedo will come within 300 yards
• Reduced strobing of radar sweep at high time scales
• Fixed bug where new side missions at bases close to player won’t activate
• Long-press of keyboard shortcuts for dive, ascend, and fire torpedoes now trigger long-press events for those actions
• Added keyboard shortcut to halt dive/ascend at current depth (default: “h”)
• Added keyboard shortcuts to dive/ascend by 1 foot (default: Ctrl-c/Ctrl-e)

notes.title: V 1.0.6 change list
notes.content:
• [b]Added enemy torpedoes![/b] Destroyers and cruisers now launch them at your submerged sub on Medium difficulty and above

• Removed time limit from “Sink the docked ship” missions
• Added hotkeys for Add/Delete/Clear Waypoints (default =/-/0)
• Added depth indicators to depth charges
• Changed radar sweep to solid circle at high time scales (to prevent strobing)

• Added link to Discord server in About screen
• Fixed Date/Time trying to localize itself into languages that aren’t yet supported (display as boxes)
• Fixed location Output not being updated on crew gaining a skill point
• Fixed periscope/binocular upgrades still applied after starting new game
• Fixed periscope binocular upgrades only applying the highest zoom level (skipping intermediate zoom levels)
• Fixed bug where sinking a side mission target ship after loading a saved game might not mark mission as complete
